Agent Maturity Compass

Usage: amc <command> [options]

Start with a task:
  amc agent-loop guide             Run a native task with explicit provider setup
  amc agent-loop chat              Continue native tasks interactively
  amc                              Assess existing evidence (baseline/assessment)
  amc connect                      Connect an existing agent
  amc agent-loop verify <sessionId>Verify recorded native task evidence

Primary command groups:
  evidence  Evidence integrity, transparency, and bundle export
  score     Maturity scoring and diagnostic execution
  incidents Incident workflows, alerts, and regression detection
  audit     Audit binder, evidence requests, and control maps
  admin     Operational health, identity, vault, and trust controls
  lifecycle Workspace bootstrapping, bring-up, and routine verification
  eval      Evaluation shortcuts for runs, comparisons, and what-if

High-signal commands:
  evidence
  amc evidence verify              Run the workspace verification suite
  amc verify all                   Full trust/policy/plugin verification
  amc bundle export                Export signed evidence bundle
  amc transparency verify-bundle   Verify transparency export bundle
  score
  amc score tier                   Interactive quick/standard/deep scorecard
  amc score production-ready       Production readiness gate check
  incidents
  amc incident list                List incidents by agent
  amc incident create              Open a manual incident
  amc incidents alert              Dispatch INCIDENT_CREATED event
  amc drift check                  Detect drift that can trigger incidents
  audit
  amc audit binder create          Build an audit binder artifact
  amc audit request list           List open evidence requests
  amc audit map verify             Verify active compliance maps
  amc audit verify                 Verify audit policy signatures
  admin
  amc setup                        Guided first-time environment setup
  amc doctor                       System health + misconfiguration checks
  amc admin status                 Control plane status and signatures
  amc vault status                 Vault lock/unlock state
  lifecycle
  amc resource validate            Validate governed resource drift
  amc resource apply               Dry-run or accept governed resource changes
  eval
  amc eval run                     Alias for diagnostic run
  amc whatif equalizer             Run equalizer what-if simulation
  amc e2e smoke                    Run deterministic smoke verification

Global options:
  --agent <agentId>                  Agent ID override
  --no-color                         Disable ANSI color output (or set NO_COLOR=1)
  -h, --help                         Show command help
  -V, --version                      Show CLI version

Discoverability:
  amc help <command>                 Detailed help for any command path
  amc shell                          Interactive REPL session
  amc --help --all                   Complete command list
